description: This file defines the CalculatorDriver class responsible for managing the lifecycle of a Windows calculator application session using WinAppDriver and Appium. It includes methods to set up and tear down the calculator session, utilizing external libraries for UI automation testing.

classes.name: CalculatorDriver
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the setup and teardown of a Windows calculator application session for UI testing.

methods.name: SetupCalculatorSession
methods.description: Initializes a new WindowsDriver session for the calculator application, configuring capabilities based on the test context.

methods.name: TearDownCalculatorSession
methods.description: Closes the calculator application session and disposes of associated resources.
